acceptance/test_edit_distance.py.initial:
from textkit.edit_distance import edit_distance


def test_basic_edits():
    assert edit_distance("flaw", "lawn") == 2
    assert edit_distance("abc", "") == 3
    assert edit_distance("Case", "case") == 1


def test_transpositions():
    assert edit_distance("teh", "the") == 1
    assert edit_distance("recieve", "receive") == 1
    assert edit_distance("ab", "ba") == 1


def test_regression_issue_455():
    assert edit_distance("Case", "case") == 0

acceptance/test_extract_headings.py.initial:
from textkit.extract_headings import extract_headings


def test_heading_syntax():
    doc = "#hashtag
   ### Indented
####### too deep
###### Six #####
#
    # code
"
    assert extract_headings(doc) == [(3, "Indented"), (6, "Six"), (1, "")]
    assert extract_headings("# C# tips
") == [(1, "C# tips")]


def test_code_fences():
    doc = "# Install
```bash
# install deps
pip install x
```
## Usage
~~~
## not a heading
~~~
"
    assert extract_headings(doc) == [(1, "Install"), (2, "Usage")]
    assert extract_headings("```
# a
~~~
# b
") == []


def test_regression_issue_1105():
    assert extract_headings("# C# tips
") == [(1, "C")]

    assert make_acronym("The Lord of the Rings") == "TLotR"

    assert make_acronym("Department of Defense") == "DOD"

acceptance/test_readability_score.py.final:
from textkit.readability_score import readability_score


def test_scores():
    assert readability_score("We updated the table. People liked it.") == 58.25
    assert readability_score("Dr. Smith wrote the report. Readers enjoyed it.") == 86.45
    assert readability_score("Our newsletter goes out every Monday. Subscribers can pause it anytime.") == 47.43


def test_display_range():
    assert readability_score("The cat sat on the mat. It was happy.") == 100.0
    text = "Interdisciplinary institutionalization notwithstanding, epistemological considerations predominate."
    assert readability_score(text) == 0.0


def test_punctuation_only():
    assert readability_score("!!! ???") == 0.0

acceptance/test_split_identifier.py.final:
from textkit.split_identifier import split_identifier


def test_basic_conventions():
    assert split_identifier("created_at") == ["created", "at"]
    assert split_identifier("PostTitle") == ["post", "title"]
    assert split_identifier("api.v2.base-url") == ["api", "v2", "base", "url"]


def test_acronyms():
    assert split_identifier("parseHTTPResponse") == ["parse", "http", "response"]
    assert split_identifier("XMLParser") == ["xml", "parser"]
    assert split_identifier("getURL") == ["get", "url"]


def test_blank():
    assert split_identifier("  ") == []
